notes: Summary: Springline is building a customer support deflection layer and an agent assist UI. Primary concern is tight latency — they need P95 end-to-end for top-5 results <=150ms for agent flows and <=200ms for end-user deflection. Index size: expect 8–12M docs (tickets + KB + product guides). Cost sensitivity: target blended cost per query <= $0.003 (embeddings + rerank). They prefer embedding + ANN store for recall, then a lightweight reranker for top-5 precision. Deployment: must run in VPC with option to move to Dedicated pools. Security: strict residency rules for EU subset of customers, SOC2 required, Azure AD SSO (SAML). Quotes from call: "We need the deflection dropdown to be instant — agents can't wait." — Evan Liu. They asked for a short security FAQ and an architecture diagram for VPC private endpoints.
requirements_summary: POC goals: 1) Index 10M tickets+KB, ingest cadence daily; 2) P95 latency for top-5 rerank <=150ms in agent context; 3) Average cost per query <= $0.003; 4) SSO + audit logs + KMS; 5) Fallback policy to cheaper model when latency spikes. Tech preferences: 1536-dim dense embeddings, HNSW ANN with warm-hot shards for low-latency corridors; reranker model quantized 8-bit for faster CPU/GPU inference. Need metrics: token-level cost, rerank precision@5, throughput per GPU, cold-start times.
